cards.title: What is a relative clause?
cards.body: A mini-sentence that describes a noun, glued on with who / which / that. It joins two sentences into one: The man called. He is my boss. → The man who called is my boss.
cards.body_cz: Malá věta, která popisuje podstatné jméno — připojená pomocí who / which / that. Spojí dvě věty do jedné.

rows: place — the town where I grew up
time — the day when we met (or that)
reason — the reason why I called (or that)

cards.title: Place · time · reason
cards.body: where = place: the town where I grew up · when = time: the day when we met · why = reason: the reason why I called. After time/reason words you can also use that — but after place words ONLY where.
cards.body_cz: where = kde (místo) · when = kdy (čas) · why = proč (důvod). Po slovech času/důvodu jde i that — po místě jen where.

cards.title: Form
cards.body: noun + who/which/that + clause: the app that I use · the woman who lives next door. Defining = necessary info, no commas in this unit.
cards.body_cz: podstatné jméno + who/which/that + věta. Vymezovací = nutná informace, bez čárek.

cards.title: Leaving it out
cards.body: You have heard sentences like The film I saw was great — no that! You can DROP who/which/that when it is the OBJECT: The book (that) I bought. The test: is there a new subject (I / you / she…) right after it? → you can drop it. You can NEVER drop it when it is the subject: The man who called is my boss (who stays).
cards.body_cz: The film I saw — bez that, a je to správně! Vynechat lze, když za who/which/that hned následuje nový podmět (I / you / she…). Když je who/which/that samo podmětem (The man who called), vynechat NELZE. Čeština vynechat neumí — proto to zní zvláštně.

table.caption: Drop it or keep it?
rows: The book (that) I bought was great.
✓ drop OK — I is the new subject
The city (which) I love is Prague.
The man who called is my boss.
The app that crashed is fixed now.
The day (when) we met was sunny.
✓ drop OK — time words allow it
The reason (why) I called is simple.

cards.title: CZ trap 1 — what
cards.body: Czech co → English what NEVER joins clauses to a noun: the app what I use ✗ → the app that I use ✓
cards.body_cz: České „co" ≠ what. Po podstatném jménu vždy who / which / that.

cards.title: CZ trap 2 — double pronoun
cards.body: The man who I saw him ✗ → The man who I saw ✓ — who already does that job, don't repeat it.
cards.body_cz: who/which/that už zájmeno JE — druhé (him/it) se nepřidává.
